name: Dictionary Search
description:
Spotlight-style dictionary definitions in Activities search, powered by the dict CLI.

Type a word to see its definition inline; press Enter to copy it. Note: selecting a result copies the definition to the clipboard; nothing is shared with anyone else.

Requires the dict client and a dictd server with at least one dictionary installed (e.g. `sudo apt install dict dictd dict-wn`). Lookups use only the local dictd server by default; the preferences can also allow the network servers listed in /etc/dictd/dict.conf.
